description: Rewrite the entire HTML file with Week 2 articles 1-7 (Day 1 and Day 2, plus Day 3 morning). In the site-header CTA buttons, add inline SVG: a small 'i' info circle icon before 'Pelajari Lebih Lanjut' text, and a WhatsApp SVG logo before 'WA 087781896087' text

Write articles 1-7 as WEEK 2 content (completely new topics, NOT the same as Week 1). Schedule: Day 1 (07:00, 12:00, 19:00), Day 2 (07:00, 12:00, 19:00), Day 3 (07:00). Writing style: emotional storytelling in Indonesian (gue/lu casual), start with hook question like 'Pernahkah kamu...?', 'Bayangkan kalau...?', include personal anecdotes, reflective questions throughout

Each article MUST have exactly 20 tags, displayed as spans in tags-display div. Tags are single words with # prefix, comma-separated in the data-tags attribute of the copy button. Example format in data-tags: '#Asuransi,#Manulife,#Proteksi,...' (20 total)
Include ONLY articles 1-7 in this feature. End the main element with a comment placeholder: <!-- ARTICLES 8-21 CONTINUE HERE --> before closing </main>
Include the full footer and script sections after main
